cards.title: Vision
cards.description: To help shape a future where technology is thoughtful, accessible, and quietly powerful: reducing unnecessary complexity, expanding human capability, and creating products that make work and everyday life feel clearer, more humane, and more meaningful.

cards.title: Mission
cards.description: To keep learning across engineering, product, and human experience; understand the real systems and constraints behind a problem; and turn that understanding into reliable, versatile, and cognitively easy products that create durable value for the people and organisations they serve.
